responsibility: Implements the generic machinery for elaborating MIR drop terminators into explicit control flow that tests and clears drop flags, recursively drops subpaths, handles partial moves, and emits the blocks needed for normal and unwind cleanup paths.
same_name_distinction: This `elaborate_drops.rs` contains the reusable framework for expanding a drop into control-flow and drop-flag tests/resets via the `DropElaborator` trait. The transform-side file of the same name is the pass-specific client that feeds MIR/dataflow facts into this generic machinery.
